historyInstance.label: History instance
historyInstance.help: Meter, group, tariff and KPI states this adapter creates are automatically configured for history logging on this instance.

snapshotCron.label: Snapshot schedule
snapshotCron.help: How often every meter's current value is snapshotted for period-based KPIs (self_consumption_ratio, autarky, cop, ...) - see MeterOps-Concept.md's ratio-KPI limitation.

registryConfig.label: Registry config (JSON)
registryConfig.help: Meter/group/tariff registry as JSON - see MeterOps-Concept.md. A dedicated table editor for meters/groups/tariffs, and a custom nested editor for per-meter sources, are planned as a follow-up.
